title: Code following exhaustive if and elseif branches that both return is unreachable

ground_truth.statement: Every bool input enters either if ($flag) and returns 1 or elseif (!$flag) and returns 2, so the trailing return 3 is unreachable.

allowed.reason: The negated boolean condition in elseif (!$flag) is always true after the first branch returns; this is a correct secondary diagnostic.

notes: Mago 1.60.2 detects unevaluated-code directly after return/throw/if-else, but fails to mark trailing code unreachable after exhaustive if/elseif termination (even though Mago itself proves !$flag is always true via redundant-condition). PHPStan 2.3.1 reports deadCode.unreachable at line 15. Psalm 6.20.1 also omits UnevaluatedCode here (even with findUnusedCode="true").
